title: SymbolicSystem takes ObjectJointUser: algebraic equations and reaction forces of the recorded joints
author: Claude-JG
description: SymbolicSystem with ObjectJointUser on rigid markers of user bodies and the ground: nAE, AlgebraicEquations from the recorded constraintUserFunction with the marker states, ReactionForces C_q^T lambda from the recorded jacobianUserFunction projected by the marker Jacobians as the connector forces; SolveGeneralizedAlpha against SolveDynamic.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem.SymbolicSystem takes ObjectJointUser with symbolic constraint and Jacobian functions: AlgebraicEquations and ReactionForces (C_q^T lambda through the marker Jacobians), so that SolveGeneralizedAlpha integrates systems with the joints of UserItemCreator; the output of the solvers with joints by Exudyn's implicit solver.
